programme.title: Downton Abbey: A New Era
programme.desc: The Crawley family goes on a grand journey to the South of France to uncover the mystery of the dowager countess's newly inherited villa. Starring Hugh Bonneville, Jim Carter, Michelle Dockery.

programme.title: In Cold Light
programme.desc: Fresh out of prison, young Ava tries to reclaim her drug empire but gets framed for murder instead. Hunted by cops and a ruthless crime boss, she must face her estranged father as she battles betrayal amid all the bloodshed. Starring Maika Monroe, Troy Kotsur, Helen Hunt.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Zach and Emmy's trip on a hot-air balloon takes a terrifying turn when they get hijacked by a passenger with a link to Zach's past. As the mystery of their relationship is revealed, their spectacular ride turns into a lethal battle high in the sky. Starring Hera Hilmar, Jeremy Irvine, Kelsey Grammer.

programme.title: Little Lorraine
programme.desc: Little Lorraine, a North Atlantic seaside town with a population of 60, becomes embroiled in an international cocaine smuggling operation under the noses of multiple governments, distributed in coffins through a network of funeral homes. Starring Stephen Amell, Stephen McHattie, Auden Thornton.

programme.title: Do Not Enter
programme.desc: Thrill-seeking explorers live stream from a supposedly haunted hotel that's rumored to have a stash of $300 million. Daring to enter the abandoned site, they soon find themselves fending off supernatural creatures that stalk them from the shadows. Starring Jake Manley, Adeline Rudolph, Francesca Reale.

programme.title: Mile End Kicks
programme.desc: A 24-year-old music critic gets romantically involved with members of an indie band in Montreal. Starring Barbie Ferreira, Devon Bostick, Stanley Simons.

programme.title: Solemates
programme.desc: A love triangle between a shoe store owner, a customer and an old pair of shoes. When Andrew walks into William's store to replace his own worn old pair of brogues, interest is piqued. Starring Richard Jutras, Garrett Hnatiuk.

programme.title: Meet the Killer Parents
programme.desc: A young woman fights to escape her boyfriend's family after learning they're planning to groom her to replace their long-dead daughter. Starring Dmitry Chepovetsky, Ericka Leobrera, Bryn McAuley.

programme.title: A Big Fat Family Christmas
programme.desc: A photojournalist gets close to a co-worker as she shoots her family's annual holiday party for a cover story. Starring Shannon Chan-Kent, Shannon Kook, Tia Carrere.

programme.title: Selena + Chef
programme.desc: Ambassador of Italian cuisine Fabio Viviani joins Selena for a carb-fest.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown. Starring Jackie Chan, Ralph Macchio, Ben Wang.

programme.title: Little jesus
programme.desc: Tells the story of Jean who pins his hopes of recovering from his wounds on a miracle: his ten-year-old son. He is convinced that Loulou is the new Messiah. Starring Antoine Bertrand, Gérard Darmon, Caroline Anglade.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: With his life unraveling around him, Bernard dusts off a jewelry box and unintentionally releases genie Flora, who might just be able to help him. Starring Melissa McCarthy, Paapa Essiedu, Denée Benton.

programme.title: White Bird: A Wonder Story
programme.desc: A girl in Nazi-occupied France goes into hiding with help from a schoolmate -- a boy who risks everything to give her the chance to survive. Together, they find first love in a stunning, magical world of their own creation. Starring Ariella Glaser, Orlando Schwerdt, Helen Mirren.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organization's name. Starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his team take on their most impossible mission yet to eradicate the Syndicate -- a highly skilled, international organization dedicated to creating a new world order via a series of terrorist attacks. Starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout
programme.desc: An arms dealer and a group of terrorists plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack. When the weapons go missing, Ethan Hunt and the IMF team must race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands. Starring Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Ving Rhames.

programme.title: Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken
programme.desc: Ruby is a sweet and awkward high school student who discovers she is a direct descendant of the warrior Kraken queens. Destined to inherit the throne from her commanding grandmother, Ruby must use her newfound powers to protect those she loves most. Starring Jane Fonda, Lana Condor, Toni Collette.

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Supergirl reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion for an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice. Starring Milly Alcock, Matthias Schoenaerts, Eve Ridley.

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. Starring Lilly Singh, Sonia Dhillon Tully, Sabrina Jalees.

programme.title: I Am Luke Perry
programme.desc: Chronicles the actor's life from small-town roots to Hollywood stardom, featuring insights from family and costars. Starring Stephen Baldwin.

programme.title: Air Bud: World Pup
programme.desc: The golden retriever helps his young owner (Kevin Zegers) and his coed soccer team to shine while outsmarting a wily dogcatcher. Starring Kevin Zegers, Dale Midkiff, Caitlin Wachs.

programme.title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
programme.desc: The golden retriever joins a middle-school baseball team and searches for his missing offspring. Starring Kevin Zegers, Caitlin Wachs, Cynthia Stevenson.

programme.title: The Amazing Maurice
programme.desc: Maurice is a streetwise ginger cat who comes up with a money-making scam by befriending a group of talking rats. However, when Maurice and the rodents reach the town of Bad Blintz, their little con soon goes down the drain. Starring Hugh Laurie, Emilia Clarke, David Thewlis.

programme.title: An Autumn Romance
programme.desc: A woman tries to save a small, historic hotel from developers, but she soon realizes that the man she's falling for is behind the hotel's development plans. Starring Chad Michael Murray, Jessica Lowndes, Dennis Andres.

programme.title: My Husband's Baby
programme.desc: A famous couple's life gets turned upside down when a pregnant woman shows up claiming to be carrying the husband's child. Starring Moni Ogunsuyi, Samantha Brown, Eddie G..

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail. Starring Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott.

programme.title: Secret Headquarters
programme.desc: When Charlie and his friends discover that his dad is a powerful superhero, the youngsters spring into action to defend his secret headquarters and save the planet from a villainous threat. Starring Owen Wilson, Walker Scobell, Jesse Williams.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programme.desc: The Turtle brothers take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them. Starring Micah Abbey, Shamon Brown Jr., Nicolas Cantu.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The turtles spring into action to battle Shredder (Brian Tee), mad scientist Baxter Stockman (Tyler Perry), Bebop (Gary Anthony Williams), Rocksteady (Stephen "Sheamus" Farrelly) and the notorious Krang (Brad Garrett). Starring Megan Fox, Will Arnett, Laura Linney.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favorite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down. Starring Paul Rudd, Jack Black, Thandiwe Newton.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: The reopening of Camp Crystal Lake spells murder and mayhem for a group of sexually promiscuous counselors. Starring Betsy Palmer, Adrienne King, Harry Crosby.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2

programme.title: Back to the Future
programme.desc: In this 1980s sci-fi classic, small-town California teen Marty McFly is thrown back into the '50s when an experiment by his eccentric scientist friend Doc Brown goes awry. Traveling through time in a modified DeLorean car, Marty encounters young versions of his parents, and must make sure that they fall in love, or he'll cease to exist. Even more dauntingly, Marty has to return to his own time and save the life of Doc Brown.

programme.title: Back to the Future Part II
programme.desc: In this zany sequel, time-traveling duo Marty McFly and Dr. Emmett Brown return from saving Marty's future son from disaster, only to discover their own time transformed. In this nightmarish version of Hill Valley, Marty's father has been murdered and Biff Tannen, Marty's nemesis, has profited. After uncovering the secret to Biff's success -- a sports almanac from the future -- Marty and the Doc embark on a quest to repair the space-time continuum.

programme.title: Back to the Future Part III
programme.desc: In this final chapter, Marty McFly (Michael J. Fox) obtains a 70-year-old message from the time-traveling Dr. Emmett Brown (Christopher Lloyd), in which he informs Marty that he has retired to a small town in the Old West. Marty then finds out that the Doc was murdered shortly after sending the letter. In order to save his friend, Marty will have to travel back in time, disentangle a lovestruck Doc from a local schoolmarm, and repair the DeLorean -- all while avoiding a posse of gunslingers.

programme.title: Élémentaire

programme.title: Détectives privés

programme.title: Hawaii sauvetage extrême
programme.desc: S01 E02 — De la montagne à l'océanLorsqu'une crue soudaine emporte une jeune touriste loin de sa famille et en haute mer, Sonny, Em et Will se précipitent pour la sauver ; allant à l'encontre des souhaits de Sonny, Em prend un risque audacieux, mettant sa propre vie en danger.

programme.title: Aide-moi Todd
programme.desc: S01 E08 — Les théories du Big BangLa nièce de Lyle, Angie, est accusée d'avoir commis un crime sur le campus de l'université qu'elle fréquente ; Lyle demande à Margaret et à Todd de la représenter en cour.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: S02 E14 — En quarantaineLorsque des connaissances de Gabe sont portées disparues, Cat et Vincent partent à leur recherche; ceci ramène Vincent à l'hôpital.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: S22 E03 — Histoires de fantômesLe NCIS est appelé à enquêter lorsqu'un lieutenant rentre chez lui la veille d'Halloween et découvre qu'une fête surprise a été organisée chez lui pour quelqu'un d'autre.

programme.title: Found: les oubliés
programme.desc: S02 E15 — Disparition: des demandeurs d'asileTrent demande à Gabi de l'aider à élucider le mystère des sept enfants disparus dont lui a parlé Evans afin de savoir si son père a commis des erreurs dans le passé; Gabi commence à enquêter sur ces disparitions et cherche un lien entre les victimes.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: S10 E09 — Graves erreursEn travaillant sur le cas d'une nourrice accusée d'abus, Erin n'est pas d'accord avec la consultante en psychiatrie, la docteure Alice Dornan, concernant son diagnostic et sa suggestion de punition.

programme.title: Moonshine
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Plongée dans le monde des hors-la-loiLidia découvre que la famille doit rapidement payer une dette d'impôt de 15 000$ afin d'éviter que le Moonshine ne ferme ses portes; elle fait équipe avec son petit ami motard pour élaborer un stratagème de blanchiment d'argent impliquant du bingo.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: S18 E04 — Plonger dans l'inconnuSous la pression des rumeurs qui circulent à Hudson, Jack prend une décision surprenante; pendant ce temps, Amy s'occupe d'un poney de polo et découvre une nouvelle facette de Nathan au passage.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: S18 E05 — À la croisée des cheminsToute la famille se rend au rodéo de Hudson; les émotions sont à fleur de peau lors de la danse à la grange après qu'Amy a aidé Nathan à gérer une urgence familiale.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: S18 E06 — L'amour d'une soeurLou, Amy et Lisa partent pour Vancouver pour un voyage entre filles; Lisa se retrouve prise au milieu lorsque des vérités éclatent entre les soeurs, menaçant leur relation.

programme.title: Found: les oubliés
programme.desc: S02 E14 — Disparition: une femme libreZeke essaie d'aider Shelly, qui a découvert qu'une jeune fille qui l'a appelée a été enlevée ; Gabi refuse de solliciter l'aide de Monsieur ; Margaret essaie de comprendre ce qui est arrivé à Jamie, qui a du mal à se faire accepter.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: S07 E19 — Menace imminenteAprès la disparition d'une jeune fille dans le Queens, les membres de l'équipe découvrent que les ravisseurs l'ont utilisée comme moyen de pression pour réaliser un important vol d'explosifs, ce qui les pousse à traquer les dangereux coupables.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: S01 E10 — Le dogme de l'armurierQuand un trafiquant d'armes illégales devenu informateur est assassiné, OA prend son identité et, avec l'aide de Maggie et de leur ancien instructeur du FBI, Rowan Quinn, il s'infiltre pour mettre fin à la vente d'armes de contrebande.

programme.title: La belle et la bête

programme.title: La nouvelle
programme.desc: S01 E02La comète de Halley approche et un changement se sent dans l'air; Geoff, le lecteur de nouvelles le plus ancien du réseau, est contraint de s'éloigner du bureau; Dale pourrait connaître un avancement important dans sa carrière.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Pest controllers Wallace and Gromit must save the day when a vegetable-munching beast ravages town gardens.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Armed with their proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls, slimy specters, and full-torso, free-roaming apparitions across New York.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Now the parapsychologists (Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd) are trying to rid New York of stress-related pink slime.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: A pig (Reese Witherspoon), a mouse (Seth MacFarlane), a porcupine (Scarlett Johansson), a gorilla (Taron Egerton), an elephant (Tori Kelly) and other animals gather at a koala's (Matthew McConaughey) theater for a singing competition.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: A little girl develops extraordinary mental abilities, despite neglectful parents and a brutal headmistress.

programme.title: My Spy
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Sophie catches JJ, a hardened CIA operative, spying on her family during a routine surveillance operation. In exchange for not blowing his cover, JJ begrudgingly agrees to show the precocious girl how to be a spy.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: The fabled avenger trains an uncouth protégé to drive a Spanish tyrant out of California once and for all.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: The masked swordsman (Antonio Banderas) and his wife (Catherine Zeta-Jones) fight a European count (Rufus Sewell) plotting to block California's statehood.

programme.title: Geostorm
programme.desc: When the satellites designed to control the global climate start to attack Earth, it's a race to uncover the real threat before a worldwide Geostorm wipes out everything and everyone.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalsky, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Awakened from their hibernation pods 90 years early, two space travelers enjoy the pleasures of a budding romance until they discover that their ship is in imminent danger.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: An entrepreneur and his family begin to unravel after moving into an old country manor in England in the 1980s.

programme.title: Fightland

programme.title: Midnight's Children
programme.desc: Children born on the brink of India's independence grow up in a country that is vastly different from their parent's generation.

programme.title: Blizzard
programme.desc: A youngster learns about true friendship with the help of a magically gifted reindeer from the North Pole.

programme.title: Ever After: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: Treated as a servant by her stepmother (Anjelica Huston), a 16th-century woman (Drew Barrymore) wins the heart of the French prince (Dougray Scott).

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: S02 E11 — HauntedMagnus and the team rescue passengers and crew from a sinking ship, taking them back to Sanctuary for medical treatment.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: S02 E12 — KaliMagnus, Will and Kate travel to Mumbai to investigate a murder and the connection to the ancient cult of Kali, whose followers can foretell disaster.

programme.title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
programme.desc: The golden retriever joins a middle-school baseball team and searches for his missing offspring.

programme.title: Chasing Liberty
programme.desc: A British man accompanies the teenage daughter of the U.S. president on a European adventure.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Mr. Miyagi and his student open a bonsai-tree shop, then fight thugs sent by a millionaire toxic-waste dumper.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) uses his superhuman powers to battle his archenemy, the Green Goblin (Willem Dafoe).

programme.title: Black Sails
programme.desc: Pirate Capt. Flint faces a mutiny from his own crew; John Silver hides something of great value; Eleanor keeps order on New Providence as the Royal Navy grows stronger.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: College student Jeffrey Beaumont (Kyle MacLachlan) returns home after his father has a stroke. When he discovers a severed ear in an abandoned field, Beaumont teams up with detective's daughter Sandy Williams (Laura Dern) to solve the mystery. They believe beautiful lounge singer Dorothy Vallens (Isabella Rossellini) may be connected with the case, and Beaumont finds himself becoming drawn into her dark, twisted world, where he encounters sexually depraved psychopath Frank Booth (Dennis Hopper).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: "Crash" is about the strange lure of the auto collision, provoking as it does the human fascination with death and the tendency to eroticize danger. Most motorists will slow down to stare at the scene of a collision; they may feel their pulses quickening and become aware of the fragility of their own bodies. The characters of "Crash" carry this awareness a step further, cherishing and nurturing it. For them, a car collision is a sexual turn-on, and a jolting life force they come to crave.

programme.title: Fubar 2
programme.desc: Head bangers Terry (David Lawrence) and Dean (Paul J. Spence) are tired of barely scraping by and jump on an opportunity to go north and work on the pipelines during the holidays.

programme.title: Anthropocene: The Human Epoch
programme.desc: Filmmakers Jennifer Baichwal, Nicholas de Pencier and Edward Burtynsky travel the globe to document the impact humans have made on the planet.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Ready, set, snow! Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race, only to break down right before the finish line. Convinced that Zac cheated, Frankie demands a rematch and raises the stakes by betting his team's clubhouse. Frankie and the gang build a spectacular new race track and the stage is set for the biggest race of the season.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: On the way to a tryout with the Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: The beloved Crawleys and their intrepid staff prepare for the most important moment of their lives. A royal visit from the king and queen of England soon unleashes scandal, romance and intrigue -- leaving the future of Downton hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: While an old friend of Magnus', a pouched abnormal named Jimmy, is handing over a fire elemental to the Sanctuary team, they are attacked by a gang of criminal abnormals from Chicago; the situation presents a lot of mysteries to be solved quickly.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: When rich youngsters begin to disappear after an apparent death and then come back to life, the trail leads Will and Magnus to a drug clinic in Mexico run by Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: A Little Princess
programme.desc: When young Sara is sent to a boarding school by her well-meaning World War I-bound father, the imaginative girl makes the best of things by entertaining her friends with fanciful tales. After running afoul of the strict headmistress, Miss Minchin, Sara receives some heartbreaking news, and is forced to work in servitude. As she struggles to keep her spirits up, she makes some remarkable discoveries that may change her seemingly bleak fate.

programme.title: Little Women
programme.desc: In this 1994 adaptation of Louisa May Alcott's classic, the March sisters confront growing pains, financial shortages, family tragedies and romantic rivalries in mid-19th-century Massachusetts. Jo struggles for independence and sometimes clashes with her beloved mother and her sisters Meg, Amy and Beth. She also contends with their cranky Aunt March, their impulsive neighbor Laurie and kindly linguistics professor Friedrich Bhaer.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Bridget (Blake Lively), Carmen (America Ferrera), Lena (Alexis Bledel) and Tibby (Amber Tamblyn) are best friends living in Maryland. After many summers together, the four are finally going their separate ways for a few months: while Bridget heads to Mexico, and Lena visits family in Greece, Carmen and Tibby stay closer to home. No matter where they are, they are connected by a pair of jeans that they take turns sharing -- pants that fit all four girls and exemplify their tight bond.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Karate master Mr. Miyagi goes to Boston to attend a military reunion. There, he visits with Louisa, the widow of his former commander, and meets her granddaughter, Julie. Julie's parents were recently killed in a car accident, and she is still reeling from the loss. When Julie surprises Miyagi with her knowledge of karate, he takes her to a Buddhist monastery for training and to help her come to terms with her angst.

programme.title: The Matrix
programme.desc: Neo believes that Morpheus, an elusive figure considered to be the most dangerous man alive, can answer his question -- What is the Matrix? Neo is contacted by Trinity, a beautiful stranger who leads him into an underworld where he meets Morpheus. They fight a brutal battle for their lives against a cadre of viciously intelligent secret agents. It is a truth that could cost Neo something more precious than his life.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: Freedom fighters Neo (Keanu Reeves), Trinity (Carrie-Anne Moss) and Morpheus (Laurence Fishburne) continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression and exploitation. In their quest to save the human race from extinction, they gain greater insight into the construct of The Matrix and Neo's pivotal role in the fate of mankind.

programme.title: The Matrix Revolutions
programme.desc: In a dystopia overrun by robots, Neo (Keanu Reeves), mankind's greatest hope, is trapped in a limbo world. Meanwhile, the majority of the planet's population remains in a state of suspended virtual reality. The few humans who are cognizant of the grim realities of the world desperately try to hold off their mechanical enemies long enough for Neo to escape and save the day, but things turn disastrous when all-powerful computer program Agent Smith (Hugo Weaving) arrives in the flesh.

programme.title: Fightland
programme.sub-title: Without Me, There Is No You
programme.desc: With time running out and relationships breaking apart, Duke closes in on his target; but an unexpected countermove leaves him staring down the barrel of defeat.

programme.title: Kalinga (Care)
programme.desc: At the age of six, director Kent Donguines' mother leaves him and his family in the Philippines to become a nanny overseas. Now an adult, he shares the stories of several Filipina caregivers in Vancouver, bearing witness to their sacrifice as they struggle to reunite with their children. Kent maps out the emotional landscape and trauma of migrant labor.

programme.title: Whale
programme.desc: A young boy is sent to live with his grandparents in a remote indigenous community.

programme.title: H.appiness
programme.desc: An app designed to bring its users happiness helps a man build the perfect life, which he ends up destroying when he learns the app is faulty.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: A lovable dog must rely on some new friends to help it break out of canine prison and get back home to his owners.

programme.title: Long Life, Happiness and Prosperity
programme.desc: In "Long Life, Happiness and Prosperity," 12-year-old Mindy Ho tries Taoist magic to fix her single mother's financial situation and seemingly hopeless romantic prospects. Mindy's misdirected charms appear to cause an aging security guard to lose his job and a local butcher to win the lottery. The guard, the butcher and her mother's stories all intersect, bound together by Mindy's attempts at magical intervention.

programme.title: The War With Grandpa
programme.desc: Peter and his grandpa used to be very close, but when Grandpa Jack moves in with the family, Peter is forced to give up his most prized possession: his bedroom. Peter will stop at nothing to get his room back, scheming with friends to devise a series of pranks to drive him out. However, grandpa doesn't give up easily, and it turns into an all-out war between the two.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss. She can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: The plucky characters from a series of animated shorts, Wallace and his dog, Gromit, make their feature debut here. After starting a pest control business, the duo soon lands a job from the alluring Lady Tottington to stop a giant rabbit from destroying the town's crops. Both Wallace and the stuffy Victor vie for the lady's affections. If Wallace wants to please his pretty client, and best Victor, he needs to capture that pesky bunny.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work.

programme.title: Spaceballs
programme.desc: In a distant galaxy, planet Spaceball has depleted its air supply, leaving its citizens reliant on a product called "Perri-Air." In desperation, Spaceball's leader President Skroob (Mel Brooks) orders the evil Dark Helmet (Rick Moranis) to kidnap Princess Vespa (Daphne Zuniga) of oxygen-rich Druidia and hold her hostage in exchange for air. But help arrives for the Princess in the form of renegade space pilot Lone Starr (Bill Pullman) and his half-man, half-dog partner, Barf (John Candy).

programme.title: Armageddon
programme.desc: When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman (Billy Bob Thornton) determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry S. Stamper (Bruce Willis), who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J. (Ben Affleck), who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter (Liv Tyler), until the mission proves otherwise.

programme.title: Triple 9
programme.desc: Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

programme.title: Polytechnique
programme.desc: A misogynist massacres female engineering students.

programme.title: River
programme.desc: In the south of Laos, an American volunteer doctor becomes a fugitive after he intervenes in the sexual assault of a young woman.

programme.title: Lemonade
programme.desc: A young Romanian woman moves to the United States with her son after she marries an American man she hardly knows.

programme.title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
programme.desc: A dog that plays volleyball helps investigators solve a rash of mysterious crimes.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur (James McAvoy), Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dapper Koala Buster Moon presides over a once-grand theater that has fallen on hard times. An eternal optimist, and a bit of a scoundrel, he loves his theater above all and will do anything to preserve it. Facing the crumbling of his life's ambition, he takes one final chance to restore his fading jewel to its former glory by producing the world's greatest singing competition. Five contestants emerge: a mouse, a timid elephant, a pig, a gorilla and a punk-rock porcupine.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: This film adaptation of a Roald Dahl work tells the story of Matilda Wormwood (Mara Wilson), a gifted girl forced to put up with a crude, distant father (Danny DeVito) and mother (Rhea Perlman). Worse, Agatha Trunchbull (Pam Ferris), the evil principal at Matilda's school, is a terrifyingly strict bully. However, when Matilda realizes she has the power of telekinesis, she begins to defend her friends from Trunchbull's wrath and fight back against her unkind parents.

programme.title: My Spy
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Sophie catches JJ, a hardened CIA operative, spying on her family during a routine surveillance operation. In exchange for not blowing his cover, JJ begrudgingly agrees to show the precocious girl how to be a spy. What at first seems like an easy task soon turns into a battle of wits as Sophie proves you don't need much experience to outsmart a seasoned agent.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights.

programme.title: Geostorm
programme.desc: After an unprecedented series of natural disasters threatened the planet, the world's leaders came together to create an intricate network of satellites to control the global climate and keep everyone safe. But something has gone wrong, as the system built to protect Earth is attacking it and it becomes a race against the clock to uncover the real threat before a worldwide geostorm wipes out everything and everyone along with it.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: On a routine journey through space to a new home, two passengers, sleeping in suspended animation, are awakened 90 years too early when their ship malfunctions. As Jim and Aurora face living the rest of their lives on board, with every luxury they could ever ask for, they begin to fall for each other, unable to deny their intense attraction until they discover the ship is in grave danger. With the lives of 5,000 sleeping passengers at stake, only Jim and Aurora can save them all.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: An entrepreneur and his family begin to unravel after moving into an old country manor in England in the 1980s.

programme.title: Blizzard
programme.desc: A youngster learns about true friendship with the help of a magically gifted reindeer from the North Pole.

programme.title: Ever After: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: This updated adaptation of the classic fairytale tells the story of Danielle, a vibrant young woman who is forced into servitude after the death of her father. Danielle's stepmother Rodmilla is a heartless woman who forces Danielle to do the cooking and cleaning, while she tries to marry off her own two daughters. But Danielle's life takes a wonderful turn when she meets the charming Prince Henry.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Magnus and the team rescue passengers and crew from a sinking ship, taking them back to Sanctuary for medical treatment.

programme.title: Sanctuary

programme.title: Air Bud: Seventh Inning Fetch
programme.desc: The golden retriever joins a middle-school baseball team and searches for his missing offspring.

programme.title: Chasing Liberty
programme.desc: Anna Foster (Mandy Moore), code-named "Liberty," the daughter of the President of the United States (Mark Harmon), can't get the Secret Service off her back when she goes on dates with boys. Accompanying her father on a state visit to Prague, she eludes her protectors and meets a handsome British boy, Ben Calder (Matthew Goode), with whom she embarks on a romantic journey across Europe. But there's something she doesn't know about Ben: He's a Secret Service agent.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: Cobra Kai karate instructor John Kreese (Martin Kove) is still brooding over the defeat handed to him by Daniel LaRusso (Ralph Macchio) and Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita). With his slimy partner, Terry Silver (Thomas Ian Griffith), Kreese plans an intricate payback that involves hiring a mean-spirited ringer (Sean Kanan) to rob Daniel of his championship title. When Mr. Miyagi refuses to train Daniel, even under threat, the boy makes the mistake of turning to Terry for guidance.

programme.desc: Various participants and teachers participate in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns: Symphony No. 3 Op. 78: I
programme.desc: Paavo Järvi conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance at the Salle Pleyel in Paris, 2011.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Czech Philharmonic in this concert program featuring works by Antonín Dvořák and Gustav Mahler, recorded at the Rudolfinum, Dvořák Hall, Prague on March 1, 2019.

programme.title: Mozart
programme.desc: Violin Concerto No. 3, K. 216Mozart

programme.title: Beethoven: String Quartets No. 2, 14 & 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all the great composer's sixteen string quartets.

programme.title: B. Strozzi - Sino alla morte
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music; the ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: The training and professional growth actions for opera singers; the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena; the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Ravel: La Valse
programme.desc: Pianists Alice Sara Ott and Francesco Tristan perform at the Heidelberger Frühling of 2015.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler's "Symphony No. 2" in C minor, "Resurrection."

programme.title: Clara Haskil : le mystère de l'interprète
programme.desc: Haskil suffers from chronic health issues and lives through two world wars, which holds back her career; only after WWII does Haskil's fame begin to take off, and she finally enjoys international recognition.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, perform a rendition of Edward Elgar's Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: Schumann
programme.desc: Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11Schumann

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring Suite. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Shostakovich -- 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich's "24 Preludes and Fugues," Op. 87; the work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale.

programme.title: Bacchetti Performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in the Italian city of Savona, accompanied by I Musici di Parma.

programme.title: Beethoven
programme.desc: Symphony No. 9, Op. 125Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's "Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125".

programme.title: Martha Argerich -- A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday with a concert at Château de Chantilly, France.
